task.description:
WF-03 Step 4: Validate the pg.zig stderr suppression fix end-to-end.

Pre-checks:
- BPM_TEST_DB_URL must be set to postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test (port 5434)
- docker-compose ps | grep -E 'keycloak|db' (healthy)
- psql $BPM_TEST_DB_URL -c 'SELECT 1'
- zig build migrate (exit 0)
- python tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration (exit 0)
- zig build test-env-verify (must remain 9/9 HEALTHY)

Test runs (export BPM_TEST_DB_URL first):
- zig build test (unit tests — should match or improve on baseline 918/1003 pass, 21 fail)
- zig build test-integration-iss0607 (new regression test, 1/1)
- zig build test-integration-iss0605 (GH-537 regression test, 1/1)
- zig build test-integration-iss107 (the originally-failing test, NOW must pass 5/5 — was 0/5)
- zig build test-integration (full integration suite — count failures; expect MASSIVE reduction from 804 fails)

Write report: tests/reports/report-2026-08-07-WF03-GH542.yaml

Return PASS if:
- All pre-checks green
- New test-integration-iss0607 passes
- iss107 now passes 5/5 (was 0/5) — THIS IS THE KEY ACCEPTANCE CRITERION
- test-env-verify remains 9/9 HEALTHY
- Full integration suite shows significant failure reduction vs the 804-fail baseline
- Report written per docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md §9

FAIL only if the fix doesn't actually work end-to-end.
